note: Pin for the Pro Playwright suite, so it cannot shrink silently (a deleted spec, a test.skip, or a mistyped test() all reduce protection without turning CI red anywhere else). Mirrors frontend/playwright.config.js: testMatch '**/*.e2e.js' within ./tests/e2e, testIgnore '**/lite/**' (the retired Lite spec is on disk but never collected). Update this file in the same commit as any intended suite change; test.skip / test.fixme anywhere in the counted specs is an ERROR. Enforced by scripts/check_e2e_allowlist.py.
